headline: Yongqing Realty: Handover of New Homes Boosts Transactions! Sales Transfers in the Six Major Cities Rise Year-on-Year and Month-on-Month in July - Finance
summary: Building sales transfers in Taiwan's six major cities reached 20,506 units in July, up 12.0% month-on-month and the first month above 20,000 since January 2025. The first seven months totaled 118,000 units, down 0.9% year-on-year.
why: Property transaction volumes are a leading indicator of housing demand and credit conditions. They matter for banks, developers and construction-linked stocks.
